Model marking '224e' visible on the front in photo 0 and photo 1
A test page with grayscale patches and sample text rests on top of the machine
Watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' overlaid across both photos
No brand logo is legible on the machine
No power cable, paper trays, or output trays are clearly shown

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or is otherwise non-functional
risks.proof: Video of the copier powering up, warming up, and producing a test copy

risks.risk: Scanner or print engine defective, producing poor copy quality
risks.proof: Video of a document being scanned and copied, with the resulting copy shown

risks.risk: Toner, drum, or developer near end of life
risks.proof: Photo of the control panel showing page count and toner status

risks.risk: Paper feed or fuser unit worn, causing jams

proof_requests: Video of the copier powering on and making a copy
Photo of the control panel showing page count and toner levels
Close-up of any brand or model plate on the machine
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an office photocopier with the marking 224e visible in the photos; even with every function unproven, it can be priced at its worst case as non-working.
